name: B10-0085/2024 (S&D) – Strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian interference ahead of the upcoming presidential elections and a constitutional referendum on EU integration
title: Resolution on strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian interference ahead of the upcoming presidential elections and a constitutional referendum on EU integration
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for more EU support to help Moldova resist Russian interference before its presidential election and a referendum on joining the EU. It wants sanctions on people and groups carrying out hybrid attacks, more money and staff for the EU advisory mission in Moldova, and continued help with energy independence and reforms. It also restates support for Moldova's independence and territorial integrity and asks Russia to withdraw its troops from the Transnistrian region.

- The EU is asked to sanction those behind hybrid attacks and boost its civilian mission in Moldova.
- Moldova's government, armed forces and society would get more money, experts and support.
- The Parliament urges faster reforms and Russian troop withdrawal; the Council and Commission must now respond.
